integrity: The theorem is proved by representative-independence, affine-bijection, and symbolic self-distributivity arguments. Finite exhaustive checks are regression evidence only. The generic cross-fiber well-definedness concern was already raised publicly; originality is claimed only for the exact iff criterion and its source-example consequences.
scientific_limitations: The criterion treats only degree-one cyclic factors with fixed integer scalar parameters and the literal cross-modulus formula without independently specified transition maps. It does not classify higher-degree module factors or all medial quandles, and it does not assert that the source's printed Example 7.5 Cayley tables are invalid as abstract set-theoretic quandles.
title: Exact descent criterion for cross-modulus class-(iii) Alexander quandles
